Profile.bio: I am a journalist and TV reporter. I have worked at Grupo Cadena Media since 2024: I cover premieres, festivals and press conferences, interview artists and public figures, and write scripts and news pieces.
Profile.bioMore: I studied Journalism and Audiovisual Communication at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. Besides reporting, I direct and edit short films, shoot and post-produce video, and photograph concerts, the street and portraits. Spanish and Russian are both my native languages.
